source: Built from the firmware's protocol, not yet captured: the K2 HE (3434:0e20) on its cable, charging, its own raw HID node answering a 0xA4 request (report id 0, then 32 bytes) with 78%, 3990 mV, charging (1), USB (0x01), model 3. Its descriptor is the dongle's raw HID one. On its cable the keyboard sends nothing by itself (RyzenShine, 18 s on the cable, 2026-10-29).
